decisions.reason: As a burner component for radiant heaters, it draws directly on the firm's existing combustion and service knowledge, so the firm is well placed to refine and commercialise it within its established systems business.

The electric infrared panel heater extends the firm's known heating applications into electrified solutions that fit its lower-carbon direction, and its strong related knowledge base supports further learning after launch.

Although newer and somewhat niche, the electric halogen infrared heater still builds on the firm's infrared-heating expertise and can be improved through its in-house R&D and field feedback rather than being cut after only one year.

The industrial electric infrared hall heater is very close to the firm's core offer for large non-residential spaces and matches the strategic move toward electrified, efficient hall-heating solutions.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater is closely related to the firm's installed knowledge base, strongly aligned with its hydrogen-ready strategy, and already showed a real operating reference customer at launch.
